baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sole rooted focus word is the passive plural participle ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ, and إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ places the addressee emphatically inside its class.
baseline_models.mechanism: The envoy/message branch makes the designation relational: a sender commissions a bearer, and the bearer's defining cargo is speech originating elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: The envoy-and-message image supplies a commissioned carrier whose identity derives from another's communication.

changed_reading.before: You certainly belong to the messengers.
changed_reading.after: The assertion accredits the addressee as a commissioned carrier of another's message, not as the message's source.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive form in ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ presents the addressee as acted upon by a sending, while مِنَ marks membership among others similarly acted upon.
baseline_models.mechanism: The release-and-dispatch branch turns a static title into a vector: separation from a sender, being set in motion, and orientation toward a destination.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch, release, and setting-forth supply the outward vector latent in the passive designation.

changed_reading.after: Messengerhood is an ongoing condition of having been released from a sender toward an assigned field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ is explicitly partitive and plural: the addressee is one among a set.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch of successive groups makes the plural more than a category label; it can image a continuing sequence in which one dispatch follows another.

activation_trace.role: Successive bands and one group following another give functional force to the focus ayah's partitive plural.

changed_reading.before: You are a member of the recognized messenger class.
changed_reading.after: You stand as one link in a serial history of dispatches, with continuity rather than isolation built into the claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun retains the ر س ل inventory even though its immediate form conventionally names a sent person.
baseline_models.mechanism: The easy-motion and deliberation branches tentatively color how the commission is borne: smoothly, steadily, and without frantic self-assertion.

activation_trace.role: Ease and suppleness in movement offer an exploratory manner for carrying the commission.
Gentleness, deliberation, and measured speech add composure to the proposed mode of conveyance.

changed_reading.before: The ayah certifies that the addressee was sent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also evokes a commission carried with controlled, unforced movement and measured utterance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning gives the carried speech a hearer-directed function, following belongs to the receiver, and clear conveyance names the messenger-side endpoint. The mission therefore reaches completion in intelligible delivery even when uptake does not occur.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the commissioned carrier and the speech entrusted to that carrier.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the intended effect of the carried message at the hearer's threshold.
Following as coming after supplies a distinct receiver-side motion rather than an effect the messenger can force.
The branch explicitly names conveying a message and fixes the commission's operative endpoint at delivery.

structural_cues: 36:6 assigns warning as purpose immediately after the focus credential and its straight path.
36:10-11 contrast unchanged unbelief with a hearer who follows the reminder.
36:17 limits the village envoys' burden to clear conveyance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, divergent reception, and message-delivery; I supply the boundary that sending is fulfilled at intelligible delivery rather than compelled uptake. A live alternative is that 36:17 defines only the narrated envoys' duty, not the focus designation itself.

changed_reading.before: A messenger carries an authorized communication.
changed_reading.after: A messenger carries warning as far as clear delivery; belief or refusal is a subsequent receiver-side movement and does not retroactively cancel the sending.

context_deltas.mechanism: The partitive plural becomes a relay architecture: an initial plurality is reinforced by another envoy, and a distant hearer follows them and retransmits their imperative to his own people.

activation_trace.role: Successive companies anchor the baseline claim that the focus addressee belongs to a serial rather than solitary mission.
The arrival of sent ones makes a dispatched company concrete inside the surah.
Sending two and their collective self-designation realize the succession branch as staged plurality.
Explicit reinforcement by a third turns plurality into functional strengthening rather than mere counting.
Following the sent ones lets a receiver become the next moving link when he addresses his people.

structural_cues: 36:13-17 stages a plural mission, addition of a third, collective speech, and clear delivery.
36:20 introduces a man from the city's farthest point who repeats the call to follow the sent ones.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural envoys, reinforcement, and a follower who speaks onward; I infer a relay in which reception can propagate the dispatch. Alternatively, the village episode may only exemplify messenger plurality without defining a general transmission topology.

changed_reading.before: The focus addressee belongs to a succession of commissioned figures.
changed_reading.after: He belongs to a reinforced relay in which multiple envoys and a responsive hearer keep the commissioned speech moving beyond its first bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The easy-motion branch is relocated from external success to route fidelity. A straight, balanced course belongs to the sent one while barriers and failed sight belong to receivers; smooth commission and obstructed reception can therefore coexist.

activation_trace.role: Ease and suppleness in movement provide the tentative focus-side quality that context must test.
The straight-road image gives the dispatch a defined route immediately after the focus claim.
Straightness, balance, and alignment specify the quality of that route and of remaining upon it.
Barriers that close the interval localize obstruction on the recipients' side of the encounter.
The loss of ocular seeing while people race toward the path sharpens the split between an available route and access to it.

structural_cues: 36:4 directly follows ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ with عَلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ.
36:8-10 depicts immobilized, screened, and unresponsive recipients.
36:61 repeats the straight path, while 36:66 imagines racing toward it without sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies easy-motion lexical material, a straight route, and blocked sight; I assign ease to the messenger's disciplined mode rather than to audience response. A live alternative is that the easy-motion branch is collateral and contributes nothing to this participle.

changed_reading.before: The sending may evoke an easy, unforced journey.
changed_reading.after: Its ease is disciplined route fidelity under resistance: the messenger's course stays aligned even when receivers cannot or will not traverse it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation and reminder make carried speech repeatable, while writing and a remaining mark supply a model for persistence after the first event. The personal courier can thus initiate a transmissible trace whose address continues beyond his immediate voice.

activation_trace.role: The carried-message branch anchors continuity in the content borne by the sent person.
Reading and recitation place repeatable voiced text immediately before the focus credential.
A reminder as something that reactivates memory gives the message repeatable force after initial delivery.
Ordered letters and the written object supply a durable medium for what would otherwise pass with speech.
A remaining mark that indicates what preceded supplies persistence and later recoverability.
Recollection after absence makes the closing description of the discourse a mechanism of renewed presence.
The return of recitation near the surah's close confirms repeatability as a property of the conveyed discourse.

structural_cues: 36:2 places recitation immediately before the focus credential.
36:12 joins writing with effects left behind.
36:69 returns to reminder and recitation near the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, reminder, writing, and surviving traces; I infer a migration of the carried message from person to repeatable medium. The material alternative is that 36:12 records deeds rather than revelation, making its contribution analogical rather than a direct statement about message preservation.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is the live bearer of entrusted speech.
changed_reading.after: The messenger initiates a conveyance that can outlive the live encounter as recited, remembered, and trace-bearing discourse.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the resurrection scene, the root of awakening also carries the image of sending a delegate, and the newly stirred speakers immediately affirm the sent ones. The messenger's earlier outward dispatch is mirrored by the audience's later removal from rest and movement into verification.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch anchor the focus designation as movement initiated by another.
Stirring what was still from its rest supplies the recipients' abrupt counter-movement.
The same root's sending-and-directing of an emissary makes the resurrection movement structurally comparable to commission.
Fulfillment in deed turns the promised event into belated verification of the carried warning.
The resurrected speakers explicitly recognize the prior message-bearers at the point of fulfillment.

structural_cues: 36:31-32 contrasts generations that do not return with universal presentation.
36:51-53 stages the blast, emergence from graves, the question of who raised them, and immediate vindication of the sent ones.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies awakening from rest, the dispatch sense inside that root, and explicit vindication of the messengers; I infer a mirrored motion in which former recipients are themselves relaunched into recognition. The live alternative is a simpler temporal reading: resurrection merely proves the warning without echoing messenger-dispatch.

changed_reading.before: The focus credential validates a commission in the present.
changed_reading.after: It names the first half of a delayed encounter: one party is sent with warning now, and the other will be stirred and sent out from rest into its verification.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from human commission to solar and orbital motion. It remains anchored in the focus root's dispatch and easy-movement branches and in the context branch where a runner can itself mean an agent or messenger. Downstream prose should present it only as a shared trajectory schema, never as an equation of the messenger with a celestial body or as a lexical translation of ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus participle can retain the ر س ل images of being released into motion and moving with ease.

activation_trace.role: Release and dispatch give the focus word an initiated outward trajectory.
Easy, smooth movement supplies the manner of travel in the exploratory analogy.
The running branch explicitly extends to an agent or messenger, linking solar course to commissioned motion without identifying their subjects.
Fixity and settlement give the moving course an assigned terminus rather than aimless release.
Measured governance supplies the ordering intelligence behind the course.
The celestial track supplies a bounded channel in which directed motion occurs.
Running and swimming supply sustained movement within that channel.

changed_reading.before: A sent one travels from commissioner to audience.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sent one is a human instance of routed motion: released, sustained, measured, and bounded by an assigned course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the ر س ل images of recurrent milk and freely given ease. It remains anchored by those packet branches and by the surah's no-wage, provision, benefit, and drink sequence. Downstream prose must label it a functional analogy of sustaining, nontransactional flow and must not translate ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ as milk, food, or material provision.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root inventory includes recurrent milk-yield and giving with ease alongside ordinary dispatch.

activation_trace.role: Recurrent milk and yield supply the odd but anchored image of a sustaining flow.
Ease and willing giving make that proposed flow noncoercive and nontransactional.
Request and demand are explicitly negated of the sent ones, removing extraction from the exchange.
Compensation for work supplies the payment category that the messengers do not seek.
Allocated giving supplies the wider economy of provision through which the no-fee message can be viewed.
Benefit opposed to harm names the sustaining effect proposed for the freely conveyed warning.
Taking in liquid returns the activation to the focus inventory's materially flowing branch.

changed_reading.before: The messenger delivers a communication without asking payment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the commission behaves like freely issued sustenance: a recurring beneficial flow whose bearer does not extract a price.

strongest_changes: The carried-message baseline gained a firm delivery boundary: warning and clear conveyance belong to the messenger, while following or refusal belongs to the hearer.
The partitive plural became a reinforced relay through the two envoys, the third, and the distant follower who speaks onward.
The resurrection scene mirrored dispatch: those once addressed are stirred from rest and then validate the sent ones.
Recitation, reminder, writing, and remaining traces extended live messenger-bearing into durable repeatable conveyance.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context turned a one-word credential into several mechanisms without choosing among them: bounded delivery, relay transmission, straight-course persistence under resistance, durable trace, and delayed reciprocal movement. The packet's remote ر س ل branches also supported two contained cross-domain readings that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The easy-motion and deliberation branches may be lexical collateral rather than active coloring of this passive participle.
The writing and traces in 36:12 concern deeds directly, so their extension to message durability remains an explicit analogy.
The cosmic-course and nourishing-flow outliers are functional correspondences, not proposed lexical senses of ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ.
